title: Lead Instructor — Robotics, Programming & Electronics
description: Two-plus years teaching teenagers Arduino, Raspberry Pi, Python, and circuit-level fundamentals. Built the lab curriculum from scratch — sensors, motors, and the kind of small autonomous robots that need to fail loudly before they work quietly.

title: Embedded side-project — home telemetry
description: ESP32 + sensors + a small backend that streams readings over MQTT into Postgres, surfaced through a tiny dashboard. Solid reminder that hardware always finds the bug your unit tests didn't.

title: Open-source contributor
description: Patches and small libraries across web tooling and embedded helpers. Reply to most issues. Ignore the rude ones.

title: B.S. Computer Science
description: Graduated with a thesis on lazy rendering strategies in feed-heavy interfaces. Spent more time in the dev console than in the library.
